notes: Assassination at 60, hand-curated from simmed candidates (design/reviews/2026-10-07-rogue-curation.md) and re-searched at the raid build (design/reviews/2026-10-07-raid-builds.md). Mutilate builds, and combo points are spent from three: Cold Blood and Eviscerate, with Slice and Dice ahead of it whenever it has lapsed. Venom is not cast: the engine models it to the client's numbers, over-credits it against Vile Poisons (the client adds the two bonuses, the engine multiplies them), and still measures dropping the line as a gain, so it stays a talent the rotation does not use. Without the Mutilate talent the Mutilate line falls through to Sinister Strike. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst. 2026-11-02 guide rewrite: Stealth and Garrote on the pull, +0.55% raid 60 (Ambush -0.1%).

expected_idle.reason: Sinister Strike is the builder only for a rogue without Mutilate (its line is gated on Mutilate being unknown); from the rung where the talent is taken, Mutilate builds every combo point and Sinister Strike is idle by design.

Slice and Dice sits ahead of Eviscerate at four or more combo points, and below level 40 its short ranks lapse often enough to take every such set, so Eviscerate goes uncast on the ladder's low rungs; from level 40 on, with the talents and gear of the later rungs, Eviscerate fires. The ladder DPS at levels 10 to 38 is unchanged by the order.

engineering_notes.5: sim/rogue/mutilate.go: an untalented rogue has no Mutilate spell registered.
engineering_notes.3: Previously starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit ahead of this line instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five combo points.

priorityList.notes: Cold Blood at four or more combo points, right before the Eviscerate. It is off the global cooldown and costs nothing, so it waits for the finisher.
Slice and Dice at four or more combo points when it is down or has under 3 seconds left.
Eviscerate at four or more combo points. Mutilate gives two points a cast and three on a Seal Fate crit, so waiting for exactly five wastes a Mutilate.
Mutilate is the builder: both daggers strike, two combo points a cast, harder against a poisoned target.
Sinister Strike only before you have Mutilate.
